name: Notebuddy
tagline: One companion. A little care, every day.
description:
Meet one little companion and grow together through everyday care. Feed, play, rest, train and take walks, chat about your day, and keep your companion’s portraits in a growth album.

Choose a surprise companion or draw your own first friend. The in-app canvas offers colors, an eraser and undo. AI checks your sketch and creates a baby inspired by its features, combined with one of 9 randomly assigned species and 8 elements. Photo and file uploads are not offered. The result is an interpretation of your drawing, not an exact copy.

Walks hold up to 5 charges and recover one every 5 minutes, including time away. Each outing can be peaceful, bring 10, 20 or 30 XP, or lead to a monster encounter with a short 2D battle replay. Growth milestones are levels 1, 10, 30 and 50.

Successful care can bring a short AI reply from your companion. Care is saved before the reply, so an AI failure never undoes your action. Chat, care replies, drawing checks and portrait generation use your Anna AI allowance; checking a drawing and generating its portrait are separate requests. Failed requests may still use allowance. Random starts use a ready-made baby portrait without an automatic image-generation request.

English by default, with an optional Korean interface. Your progress, recent chat, drawing references and saved portraits stay in Anna Persistent Storage. You can explicitly start over with a new random companion or remove saved game data. A failed custom-portrait attempt keeps the same companion for retry; a received image can retry saving without another generation while the window remains open. No external API key or local image-generation setup is needed.
